title: Binary tree paths
statementMd:
Return all root-to-leaf paths as strings like `"1->2->5"`, in left-to-right order. The tree is given as a level-order list where `None` marks a missing child (like `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]`); the helper `build_tree` in the solution shows how it is read, and in your function the argument is already that list.

**Example:** `tree_paths([1, 2, 3, null, 5])` returns `["1->2->5", "1->3"]`.
hints: DFS carrying the path so far.
